title: Birdie’s Nest | Spacious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Birdie’s Nest is a designer Seagrove retreat with a large private pool, fire pit, carriage house, bikes, and quick access to the beach and Seaside.
description_expanded: Birdie's Nest Features - Large Private Pool with sun shelf measures 12ft x 26ft. Pool heating available for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Poolside seating including in-pool loungers on the sun shelf - Poolside fire pit with seating set plus an additional poolside cushioned seating set under the gorgeous trees in the landscaped backyard - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 1 Min Bike Ride to Azalea/Camelia Beach Access. Beach service available at this beach access - 4 Min Bike Ride to Seaside shopping and dining, including the famous Seaside Food Trucks - 1 Min Bike Ride to Seagrove Village Market and Surfing Deer Fine Dining - Less than 1 mile to Publix, The Perfect Pig, and Pizza By the Sea - Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances including a double oven, wine fridge, and stand-alone ice maker - great design for families who love to cook together - Do you like coffee? We have a kCup, drip, espresso, and pour-over coffee maker at the home plus an electric coffee grinder and electric frother with both hot and cold options - Dining table with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Main living area with Smart TV and Sonos System (indoor fireplace not available for guests) - Covered patio overlooking pool area with bench swing - Covered front porch with Adirondack seating - Side screened-in patio with outdoor daybed and ceiling fan for year-round outdoor lounging - Carriage House Apartment with full kitchen and laundry. Private entrance accessed via stairs - Driveway parking for 3 cars. RV, Trailer, and street parking restricted. Garage access not available. - Fenced-in and landscaped backyard with gas grill - Enclosed outdoor shower near the pool - Cotton linens and bath towels provided - Pets not allowed due to allergies. Bringing an unauthorized pet will result in a deep clean charge and possible eviction. - Concierge services including beach chair rentals, eBike rentals, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and more available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Tweet Tweet! Welcome to Birdie's Nest. This picturesque designer home is an upscale combination of style, location, and comfort. The home is perfectly located 1 block to the Azalea-Camelia Beach Access and a 4-minute bike ride to shopping and dining in Seaside. You will be close to everything while still enjoying a quiet Seagrove neighborhood. The designer interiors offer a relaxing atmosphere the moment you arrive. Tranquil tones of cream, tan, and blue are reminiscent of the nearby Gulf. Plush furniture will make you want to sink into a cozy evening after enjoying a day playing in the sands of 30A. The home provides so many amenities, you may not even want to leave! The fenced-in backyard features a private pool, lots of poolside seating, and fire pit. This 2,800+ square foot home affords plenty of space for your party of 8. The unique design includes a full carriage house apartment, complete with a full kitchen, dining, and laundry. If you are traveling with the in-laws or the nanny, this is the perfect private space for them to enjoy. Area Construction - Our area is getting more popular each year! There is a possibility of nearby construction, community changes and projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects.
